en.hubeali: Is’haq said, ‘Abu Hashim Al Ja’fary narrated to me saying,

‘I complained to Abu Muhammad of the constraint of the prison and the restraining blocks (shackles). So heasws wrote to me: ‘You will be praying Al-Zohr Salat in your own home today’. So I came out (from the prison) during the time of Al-Zohr Salat, and I prayed it in my own house just as heasws had said.

And I was (financially) constrained, so I wanted to seek Dinars from him<sup>asws</sup> in the letter, but I was too embarrassed. So when I went to my house, he<sup>asws</sup> diverted to me with one hundred Dinars and wrote to me: ‘Whenever there was a need for you, so neither be shy nor reserved, and seek it, for you will see what you love, if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires’.
